Untiring 0.13.2

  • The session panel starts with Timer, Until, and Unlimited. Settings and additional options are now in the footer.
  • Closed Lid settings use clearer language, explain when a charger is required, and keep setup details and removal in expandable sections.
  • Timer fields accept numeric input and keep hours and minutes within the supported range.

Existing licenses, preferences, and closed-lid limits are unchanged.

Requires macOS 14 or later and a valid license. Includes Apple silicon and Intel builds. Closed-lid behavior has not been verified on every Mac model or macOS version; check it on your Mac before relying on unattended work.

Untiring 0.13.1

  • New sun artwork for the app icon, menu-bar panel, and installer.
  • The menu bar shows the app icon and optional countdown, without the full app name.
  • The panel and installer use the Untiring.app name.

Your existing license, preferences, and session controls remain compatible.

Requires macOS 14 or later and a valid license. Supports Apple silicon and Intel.

Untiring 0.13.0

AwakeMac is now Untiring, with a new home at untiring.app.

  • The menu-bar panel, Settings, and license screen now use the Untiring name.
  • Your saved preferences and existing license remain compatible.
  • Sessions and optional closed-lid protection work as before.

Requires macOS 14 or later and a valid license. Supports Apple silicon and Intel.
